newsitem.title: UK: UK's Labour denies plans for privatisation drive.
newsitem.headline: UK's Labour denies plans for privatisation drive.

text.p: A Labour party source on Saturday denied the opposition party was planning a "no holds barred" review of privatisation that could lead to a mass sell-off of assets even the Conservatives have balked at selling.

The source was reacting to a Sunday Times report that said the surprise move could lead to the sell-off of assets such as Channel 4 television, the air traffic control service, the student loans and grants system and parts of the civil service.

The privatisation review, which the paper said was confirmed by senior sources, would form part of an independent audit of the government's accounts due immediately after the election, which polls tip Britain's opposition Labour party to win.
But a senior source from the office of Labour's economics spokesman, Gordon Brown, dismissed the report as "rubbish" saying there were no such plans. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7947
